title: Nalanda Mahavihara
summary: Nalanda in present-day Bihar developed as a monastic and teaching institution over many centuries. Its remains include residential buildings, shrines, stupas and works in stone, metal and stucco.

claims.text: Nalanda in present-day Bihar developed as a monastic and teaching institution over many centuries. Its remains include residential buildings, shrines, stupas and works in stone, metal and stucco.
Fifth–thirteenth-century scholastic phase; earlier remains do not establish an earlier university foundation.

Residential learning connected religious practice and organized transmission of knowledge. The institution’s main teaching period should be distinguished from earlier archaeological remains at the same location.
